I bought this bat system for my Schimpo whisperer 30cm and I’m super happy with it. It’s a game changer! My wheel head has no pins and I wasn’t sure what to do - I’m a beginner hobby potter. When I saw this on etsy, I thought it was a great and simple alternative to exchanging the whole wheel and buying extra bats. Now I have no more wonky pots and no more accidents while lifting the pots from the wheel. The only limitation is the size of the bats, but it works perfectly for me because I don’t throw large pieces. The bat system are also good in quality and feel stable while throwing. I would totally recommend it! The nice gummy bears that came with the shipment were also really appreciated :) Thank you!
